DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 証明書三通をご用意しました。枚数をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Your three copies of the certificate are ready. Please check the number.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 会社と学校へ出すので、持ち帰る時に分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 証明書三通の提出先別の仕分けを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll submit them to my company and school, so I'd like them separated when I take them home.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask to have three certificates sorted by where you will submit them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: それぞれ何通のご指定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: How many copies does each place require?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 会社は二通、学校は一通です。こちらの案内に書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 会社二通と学校一通の指定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: The company needs two, and the school needs one. It's written in these instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Show the requirements of two copies for your company and one for your school. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 同じ内容の証明書を、二通と一通に分けるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: So you want identical certificates separated into a set of two and a set of one?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。証明の内容を別にするのではなく、提出する部数の分け方です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 内容は同じだが部数が違うと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes. It's the number of copies for each destination that is different, not the information being certified.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm that the contents are the same but the required numbers of copies differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 二つの封筒へ分けてお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: We can give them to you in two separate envelopes.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 封筒の外に、自分で会社と学校と書いてよいですか。証明書の中には書き込みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 封筒に自分で用途メモを付けてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: May I write ‘company’ and ‘school’ on the outside of the envelopes myself? I won't write on the certificates inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may label the envelopes with personal notes about their purpose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ご自身の管理用のメモは、封筒へお付けいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: You may attach notes for your own organization to the envelopes.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 三通を確認しました。二通の方に会社、一通の方に学校と付けて、混ざらないよう持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 三通を確認し二封筒で持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: I've checked all three copies. I'll label the two-copy envelope ‘company’ and the one-copy envelope ‘school’ and take them home without mixing them up.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Check the three copies and take them home in two envelopes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 二つの封筒でお渡ししました。提出先の条件は、それぞれの案内でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: I've given them to you in two envelopes. Please check each destination's instructions for its submission requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 掃除用シートをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Are you looking for cleaning wipes?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 安い方の袋を選びました。このまま取り出して使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 詰替え袋だけで使えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: I chose the cheaper bag. Can I take them out and use them as they are?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask whether the refill bag alone can be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こちらは詰替え用です。対応する本体容器はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: This is a refill. Do you have the matching original container?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 持っていません。初めてなので、本体と詰替えの違いを見ていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 家に本体がなく初購入と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: No. This is my first time buying them, so I didn't check the difference between the container pack and the refill.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Answer that you have no original container at home and this is your first purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 使い方と保存の表示をご覧ください。対応する容器へ入れる商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Please read the usage and storage instructions. This product goes into the matching container.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 家の空き箱に入れるつもりでしたが、指定の容器を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 容器が必要な理由を表示で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: I was planning to put them in an empty box at home, but I'd like to check the specified container.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Read the label to check why a container is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こちらが本体付きです。初めてでしたら、少量の組合せもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: This one includes the container. If it's your first time, there's also a smaller pack with a container.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: まず試したいので、少量の本体付きにします。後で詰替えを買う時の番号も控えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 別容器流用より本体付き少量を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: I'd like to try it first, so I'll take the small pack with a container. I'd also like to note the number for when I buy refills later.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Choose a small pack with its own container rather than reusing another container. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 本体の表示に対応番号があります。この詰替えの番号と比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: The matching number is on the container's label. Please compare it with the number on this refill.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 同じ番号ですね。今日は少量の本体付きを買い、詰替え袋だけの方は戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 本体と対応詰替えの組合せを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: The numbers are the same. Today I'll buy the small pack with a container and put back the refill-only bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Choose the matching combination of container and refill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 本体付きはこちらです。詰替えは元の売場へお戻しいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Here is the pack with the container. You can return the refill to its original shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: お荷物のお問い合わせでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Is your inquiry about a shipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 控えが二枚あって、どちらが私の書類か分からなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 問い合わせ番号の控えが二枚あり特定を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I have two tracking slips and can no longer tell which one is for my documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain that you have two tracking-number slips and ask for help identifying yours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 宛先の分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Do you have anything that shows the destinations?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 私のは会社へ、友人のは学校へ送りました。友人の控えも同じ封筒へ入れていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 本人宛先と友人宛先を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Mine went to a company, and my friend's went to a school. I put my friend's slip in the same envelope too.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain your destination and your friend's destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 発送日は、それぞれ分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Do you know the shipping date for each?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 同じ日に出したので日付では分けられません。会社へ送った時の宛名の写真があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 控えの発送日が同日と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: We sent them on the same day, so I can't distinguish them by date. I have a photo of the address label from when I sent mine to the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Show that both slips have the same shipping date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 担当が資料と控えを照合します。確認前に一方の番号と決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: The person in charge will compare your information with the slips. Please don't decide on either number before we check.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 写真と合わせると、先に学校用と思った方が会社の控えでした。封筒のメモを直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 番号を宛先資料と照合して取り違えを訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Comparing it with the photo, the slip I first thought was for the school was actually the company's. I'll correct the note on the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Compare the numbers with the destination information and correct the mix-up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 会社宛ての一件について、こちらの番号で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: We'll use this number to check the one shipment addressed to the company.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 自分の会社宛てだけを問い合わせます。友人の控えは別封筒へ戻して、本人へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 正しい番号で自分の一件だけ問い合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll inquire only about my own shipment to the company. I'll put my friend's slip back in a separate envelope and give it to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Use the correct number to inquire about only your own shipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 会社宛ての番号を受け付けました。確認結果をご案内しますのでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I've accepted the tracking number for the company shipment. Please wait while we find the result for you.

DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 開演まで少しありますが、お席について何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-01.translation: There's still a little time before the performance. Is there a problem with your seat?

DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 迎えの車が来たら途中で出るので、出口に近い席を探しています。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 迎えの都合で途中退席する可能性と出口近くの席の希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll leave partway through when my ride arrives, so I'm looking for a seat near the exit.
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you may leave early because of your pickup and would like a seat near the exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通路を空けておく必要がありますので、通路沿いの空席へご案内します。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to keep the aisle clear, so I'll show you an empty seat beside the aisle.

DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前のほうが見やすそうですが、途中で立つと後ろの方の邪魔になりますね。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前方からの退席が他の観客を妨げることに気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-04.translation: The front looks easier to see from, but if I stand up partway through, I'll get in the way of the people behind me.
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Recognize that leaving from the front would disturb other audience members. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 後方のこちらなら、立ち上がる際も周囲への影響が少なそうです。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-05.translation: This seat at the back should have less impact on people around you when you stand up.

DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここに座ります。電話が来たら会場の外で話してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 後方の席を選び会場外で電話する許可を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll sit here. If I get a call, may I talk outside the hall?
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a seat at the back and ask permission to take a phone call outside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会場内では音を消しておき、着信に気づいたら静かに外へお進みください。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please silence your phone inside the hall and go outside quietly when you notice an incoming call.

DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出口の扉が閉まっていた場合は、近くの係員に声をかけます。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 扉が閉まっていれば係員に退席を申し出ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the exit door is closed, I'll ask a nearby staff member.
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask a staff member to help you leave if the door is closed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、扉の前に係員がいますので、退席したいとお伝えください。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, there is a staff member by the door. Please tell them you'd like to leave.

DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 席も出口もわかりました。同行者にも後方で待つと連絡しておきます。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 席と出口を把握して同行者へ待機場所を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I know where my seat and the exit are now. I'll also let my companion know I'll be waiting at the back.
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you know your seat and the exit and tell your companion where you will wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、このお席でお待ちください。どうぞお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-SMN-HAMADA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait in this seat, then. Enjoy the performance.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その箱だけ置いたままですが、何か気になることがありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've left just that box where it is. Did you notice something?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 札にはアジとありますが、一匹だけ形の違う魚が入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 札の魚種と一匹の形が違うことを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The label says horse mackerel, but there's one fish in it with a different shape.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that one fish's shape does not match the species on the label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その一匹はまだ別の箱へ移さず、どこで気づいたか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't move that fish to a different box yet. Please tell me where you noticed it.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三番の台でふたを開けたときです。まだ計量には回していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発見場所と未計量の状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: When I opened the lid at station three. I haven't sent it for weighing yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where you found it and that it has not been weighed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 計量前なら確認できますね。箱ごと確認待ちの場所に置いておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can check it before weighing, then. Let's put the whole box in the area for items awaiting inspection.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認待ちの札を付ければ、ほかの人が運ばずに済みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認待ちの札で誤運搬を防げるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I attach an ‘awaiting inspection’ tag, will that keep someone else from moving it?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether an awaiting-inspection tag will prevent the box being moved by mistake. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 札だけでは見落とすこともあるので、運搬担当にも口頭で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: A tag alone can be overlooked, so please also tell the transport staff verbally.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 運搬担当に、三番の箱は種類を確認するまで動かさないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 運搬担当へ箱を動かさないよう伝える意思を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell the transport staff not to move the box from station three until its fish species have been checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell the transport staff not to move the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 私が中身を確認してから、元の札も付け直します。結果はあなたにも知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check the contents and then reattach the original label. I'll let you know the result too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 結果を聞くまではその箱を残して、隣の箱の表示を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認結果を待ち別の箱の表示確認へ移ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave that box until I hear the result and check the label on the box beside it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait for the result and move on to checking another box's label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順番でお願いします。こちらの確認に行きますので、また後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do it in that order. I'll go and check this, so I'll see you again shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約画面で止まっているようですが、停留所の選択でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You seem to be stuck on the reservation screen. Is it the bus stop selection?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人は駅前で待つと言っていますが、画面には駅入口と出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の待ち合わせ場所と予約画面の停留所名の違いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend says they'll wait in front of the station, but the screen says ‘Station Entrance.’
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between your friend's meeting place and the bus stop name on the reservation screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 似た名前でも別の停留所かもしれませんので、路線図を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: They may be different stops despite the similar names. Let's look at the route map.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この便は駅のロータリーには入らず、大通りで降りるということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 路線図を読み駅ロータリーを経由しないか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Does this mean this bus doesn't enter the station roundabout and I get off on the main road?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the route map and check whether the bus bypasses the station roundabout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この図では大通り側に印がありますね。駅前の印とは分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this map, the marker is on the main-road side. It's separate from the marker in front of the station.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 歩く道がわからないので、友人に大通り側まで来てもらうか聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人に大通り側への迎えを相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't know the walking route, so I'll ask my friend whether they can come to the main-road side to meet me.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask your friend about meeting you on the main-road side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待ち合わせが決まるまでは、予約の確定をせずにお待ちになってはいかがでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Perhaps you could wait to confirm the reservation until you've settled where to meet.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今返事が来ました。その停留所の名前を送れば迎えに来てくれるそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人から停留所名を送るよう返事が来たと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: They've just replied. They say they'll come and meet me if I send them the name of that stop.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that your friend replied asking you to send the stop name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら画面の停留所名をそのまま送り、降車時刻も合わせて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then send the stop name exactly as it appears on the screen, and check your arrival time as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前と時刻を送りました。この降車停留所を選んで予約を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停留所名と時刻を送り降車場所を選択すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've sent the name and time. I'll select this stop to get off at and continue the reservation.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have sent the stop name and time and will select the drop-off stop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確定前に日付もお確かめください。どうぞお気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please also check the date before confirming. Have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出荷台へ運ぶ束はそろいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are all the bundles ready to take to the shipping station?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一束だけラベルが破れていて、注文番号の末尾が読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ラベルの注文番号末尾が読めない束を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: One bundle has a torn label, and I can't read the end of its order number.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a bundle whose order number ending is illegible on its label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 読めない束は台車に積まず、ほかの束と分けて置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't load the unreadable bundle onto the cart. Keep it separate from the others.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 隣の束と厚さは同じですが、それだけで同じ注文だとは判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 厚さだけで同じ注文と判断しないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's the same thickness as the bundle beside it, but I won't assume that means it's the same order.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not judge the order to be the same just from the thickness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうですね。製造記録と照らし合わせますので、束の置いてある場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. I'll compare it with the production record, so please tell me where the bundle is.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 棚の右端です。破れたラベルは捨てずに、そのまま残してあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 束の保管位置と元のラベルを残したことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: At the far right of the shelf. I've kept the torn label as it is instead of throwing it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State where the bundle is stored and that you have kept the original label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録では末尾が六ですが、担当者の確認が済むまではラベルを貼り替えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The record shows the last digit as six, but please don't replace the label until the person responsible has checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、六と書き足さず、担当者が確認するまで出荷待ちにしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号を書き足さず確認まで出荷待ちにする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't add a six. I'll leave it waiting for shipment until the person responsible checks it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not add to the number, and hold the shipment until it is checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認の済んだほかの束だけ先に運べますか。行き先の台番号も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you take only the other bundles that have been checked first? Please also check the destination station number.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ほかの四束は二番の台へ運び、読めない一束は棚に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認済み四束の行き先と未確認一束の扱いを復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the other four bundles to station two and leave the one with the unreadable label on the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat the destination of the four checked bundles and how you will handle the one unchecked bundle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お願いします。私は担当者を呼びに行きますので、また作業台で。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I'll go and get the person responsible, so I'll see you at the workbench.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 模様を付ける手が止まりましたね。どの部分が気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've stopped working on the pattern. Which part is bothering you?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 縁の線をそろえたかったのですが、ここだけ内側へ曲がってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 皿の縁の線が内側へ曲がった部分を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wanted to keep the line along the plate's rim even, but this part curved inward.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain where the line along the plate's rim has curved inward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 強くこすると表面まで傷むので、まず道具を置いて見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rubbing hard could damage the surface too. Please put your tool down and show me first.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この線を消すより、葉の模様につなげて残すことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 線を消さず葉の模様につなげる案を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Instead of erasing this line, could I keep it and connect it to a leaf pattern?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about keeping the line and incorporating it into a leaf pattern. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 葉に見立てるなら、この曲がりを茎に使えそうです。試し紙で形を考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you make it into a leaf design, this curve could serve as a stem. Let's work out the shape on practice paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 左右に葉を一枚ずつ描き、曲がった線を茎にする案を試します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 試し紙で曲線を茎に使う配置を試すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll try drawing one leaf on each side and using the curved line as the stem.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will try a layout using the curve as a stem on practice paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その配置なら縁にも余白が残りますね。実物へ移す前に力加減を見ておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: That layout leaves some space at the rim too. Let's check how much pressure to use before you put it on the actual piece.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙のときより軽く押すのですね。まず小さい葉から付けてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実物では軽く押して小さい葉から付けると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I should press more lightly than on the paper. I'll start with a small leaf.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will press lightly on the actual piece and start with a small leaf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その程度で十分です。残りの葉も間隔を見ながら付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: That much pressure is enough. Please add the remaining leaves while checking the spacing.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 失敗した線を生かせました。残りはこの間隔で仕上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 曲線を生かせたことと残りの仕上げ方を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've managed to make use of the line I got wrong. I'll finish the rest with this spacing.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you made use of the curved line and explain how you will finish the rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 仕上げが済んだら作業台へお持ちください。それでは、ゆっくりお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring it to the workbench when you've finished. Take your time and enjoy it.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請用紙を書き終えましたか。お出しになる前にお困りの点を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished the application form? Before you submit it, please tell me if you're having any trouble.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前の住所を書く欄に、今住んでいるアパートの住所を入れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧住所欄へ現住所を書いた間違いを申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put the address of the apartment where I live now in the previous-address field.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you mistakenly wrote your current address in the previous-address field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは以前の住所の欄ですね。まだ提出前ですので、記入箇所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the previous-address field, yes. You haven't submitted it yet, so let's check the fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新しい用紙に書き直したいです。今の用紙は提出せず手元に置いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新しい用紙への書き直しと旧用紙の扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to fill out a new form. May I keep this one with me without submitting it?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about filling out a new form and what to do with the old one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、新しい用紙をお渡しします。住所が二つありますので、欄の見出しを先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, I'll give you a new form. There are two addresses, so please check the field headings first.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 旧住所には引っ越す前の家、現住所には今のアパートを書くのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧住所と現住所の欄の区別を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The previous-address field is for my home before I moved, and the current-address field is for my apartment now, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Repeat the distinction between the previous-address and current-address fields. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その区別で読めています。部屋番号も、現在のお住まいの資料で確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You're reading that correctly. Let's also check your room number against your current housing documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約書では二〇三号室です。マンション名の後に部屋番号も入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 契約書で部屋番号を確かめ記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The contract says room two hundred and three. I'll include the room number after the apartment building's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the room number in the contract and enter it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入が済んだら、申請する証明書の種類と枚数も見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you've filled it out, please also review the type and number of certificates you're applying for.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所を分けて書き直し、必要な証明書一通の欄にも印を付けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所の修正と必要な証明書一通の選択を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've rewritten the addresses in their separate fields and marked the box for the one copy of the certificate I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that you corrected the addresses and selected one required certificate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは受付へお進みください。ご記入ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed to reception, then. Thank you for filling it out.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鍵を拾われたのですね。どちらで見つけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You found some keys, I see. Where did you find them?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公園のベンチの下で拾いました。青い布の袋に入っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公園のベンチ下で青い袋入りの鍵を拾ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found them under a park bench. They were in a blue cloth bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you found keys in a blue bag under a park bench. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 公園の名前と、見つけた時刻を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you tell me the park's name and what time you found them?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の看板には中央公園とありました。今日の昼休み、一時ごろです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 公園の看板名と発見時刻を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The sign at the entrance said Central Park. It was around one o'clock during my lunch break today.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the park name shown on the sign and the time you found the keys. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ベンチは入口から見てどのあたりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Where is the bench in relation to the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水飲み場の隣のベンチです。袋を開けると鍵が見えたので、交番へ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベンチの位置と交番へ届けた経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's the bench beside the drinking fountain. When I opened the bag, I saw the keys, so I brought them to the police box.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the bench's location and how you came to bring the keys to the police box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発見状況を記録しますので、いま伺った場所と時刻に間違いがないか確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record the circumstances of the discovery. Please check that the place and time you've just given are correct.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水飲み場の隣で、一時ごろです。記録の内容は合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記録された場所と時刻が正しいと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Beside the drinking fountain, at about one o'clock. The details in the record are correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the recorded location and time are correct. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この後の手続きで連絡先などを伺います。わからない欄は空けたままお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Next we'll ask for your contact details and other information. Please leave any fields you don't understand blank and ask us.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先は書けますが、この欄の意味がわからないので説明をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を記入できるが不明な欄の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can fill in my contact details, but I don't understand this field. Could you explain it, please?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you can enter your contact details and ask for an explanation of an unclear field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その欄を説明してから受付を進めます。お届けいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll explain that field before continuing with the report. Thank you for bringing the keys in.
